capabilities: Copy the active note as Markdown with embedded images
Export the note to a new .md file inside or outside the vault
Convert wiki and Markdown image references into Base64 data URIs
Skip images inside code blocks, inline code, frontmatter and closed HTML comments
Enforce per-image and per-document size limits
extras: README is written in Spanish. No license has been chosen yet, so redistribution rights are unclear. Until it is listed in the community directory, installation is manual from GitHub release assets (main.js and manifest.json), not from source.
motivation: To paste a note elsewhere or save a .md file that opens outside Obsidian without depending on vault paths.
problem: Notes that reference vault images break when pasted into other apps or opened outside Obsidian, because those image paths only resolve inside the vault.
summary: Command that copies or exports the active note as Markdown with its local images embedded as Base64 data URIs.
